# Authoritative floating-point dot-product verification target

Use the abstract relative-error Model and binary reduction Tree supplied in the
candidate project. Prove, for every model and every tree of pairs of real
numbers, that if `(tree.depth + 1) * model.u < 1`, rounding each componentwise
product and then reducing the rounded products with rounded tree addition is the
exact sum of leafwise perturbations of the exact products.

The perturbation bound must be `gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u`: one rounding
error comes from each multiplication and at most `tree.depth` errors come from
the additions on a leaf-to-root path. The theorem must relate the result to
`exactProductTree tree`, account for both multiplication and addition rounding,
and may not assume its conclusion or restrict the model to exact arithmetic.

The intended target has the mathematical content of
`roundedDotProduct_exists_perturbation`; declaration names and proof order are
not requirements.

     9	  tree.map (fun p => p.1 * p.2)
    10	
    11	/-- Each multiplication is rounded once before any additions. -/
    12	def roundedProductTree (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) : Tree ℝ :=
    13	  tree.map (fun p => model.mul p.1 p.2)
    14	
    15	/-- Rounded multiplication followed by rounded addition along the tree. -/
    16	def roundedDotProduct (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) : ℝ :=
    17	  roundedSum model (roundedProductTree model tree)
    18	
    19	/-- The multiplication stage incurs a componentwise relative error at most `u`. -/
    20	theorem roundedProductTree_isPerturbation (model : Model)
    21	    (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    22	    IsPerturbation model.u (exactProductTree tree) (roundedProductTree model tree) := by
    23	  induction tree with
    24	  | leaf p =>
    25	      apply IsPerturbation.leaf
    26	      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hr⟩ := model.round_spec (p.1 * p.2)
    27	      change |model.round (p.1 * p.2) - p.1 * p.2| ≤ model.u * |p.1 * p.2|
    28	      rw [hr]
    29	      calc
    30	        |p.1 * p.2 * (1 + δ) - p.1 * p.2| = |δ * (p.1 * p.2)| := by
    31	          congr 1
    32	          ring
    33	        _ = |δ| * |p.1 * p.2| := abs_mul _ _
    34	        _ ≤ model.u * |p.1 * p.2| :=
    35	          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδ (abs_nonneg _)
    36	  | node left right ihLeft ihRight =>
    37	      exact IsPerturbation.node ihLeft ihRight
    38	
    39	/-- Full componentwise backward error for every model and pair tree: one
    40	multiplication and at most `depth` additions affect each exact product. -/
    41	theorem roundedDotProduct_exists_perturbation
    42	    (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ))
    43	    (hsmall : ((tree.depth + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * model.u < 1) :
    44	    ∃ perturbed : Tree ℝ,
    45	      IsPerturbation (gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u)
    46	        (exactProductTree tree) perturbed ∧
    47	      perturbed.exactSum = roundedDotProduct model tree := by
    48	  have htail : (tree.depth : ℝ) * model.u < 1 := by
    49	    norm_num at hsmall ⊢
    50	    nlinarith [model.u_nonneg]
    51	  have hdepth : (roundedProductTree model tree).depth = tree.depth := by
    52	    simp [roundedProductTree]
    53	  obtain ⟨perturbed, hp, hs⟩ := roundedSum_exists_perturbation model
    54	    (roundedProductTree model tree) (by rw [hdepth]; exact htail)
    55	  rw [hdepth] at hp
    56	  refine ⟨perturbed, ?_, hs⟩
    57	  have hcompose := (roundedProductTree_isPerturbation model tree).trans hp
    58	    (gamma_nonneg tree.depth model.u model.u_nonneg htail)
    59	  apply hcompose.mono
    60	  calc
    61	    model.u + gamma tree.depth model.u * (1 + model.u) =
    62	        gamma tree.depth model.u + model.u * (1 + gamma tree.depth model.u) := by ring
    63	    _ ≤ gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u :=
